help.title: How to use
help.gettingStartedDesc: Download manga and doujinshi for offline reading. Supports 28 sites with automatic content detection.
help.step1: Copy a manga/doujin URL from any supported site and paste it into the input field above.
help.step2: Click 'Download'. For one-shots, the download starts immediately. For series, a chapter selection dialog will appear.
help.step3: Monitor progress in the download history below. Completed items can be opened directly in the viewer.
help.clipboardDesc: When enabled, the app automatically detects manga URLs copied to your clipboard from supported sites. Just copy a URL from your browser and the download will start automatically.
help.clipboardSingle: Single chapters and one-shots will auto-download from any page on a supported site.
help.clipboardSeries: Series will redirect you to the Downloads page where you can select which chapters to download.
help.supportedSitesDesc: 28 sites supported across multiple languages and content types.
help.settingsDesc: Click the gear icon to configure parallel download limits for faster batch downloads.
help.parallelChapters: Parallel Chapters — how many chapters download simultaneously.
help.parallelImages: Parallel Images — how many images download concurrently within each chapter.
help.autoResume: Auto-resume — automatically retry interrupted downloads on app restart.
help.tipSeries: For series, you can select specific chapters or use 'Select All' in the chapter picker.
help.tipHistory: Use 'Resume' on failed or cancelled downloads to continue from where they left off.
help.tipFolder: Change the download folder in Settings to organize your collection.

help.title: Help & Information
help.appearanceDesc: Customize the visual theme, accent color, language, and toggle which sections appear in the sidebar menu.
help.appearanceTip: Each theme supports custom accent colors. Use the color picker to personalize your experience.
help.networkServerDesc: Enable this to access Manga Visor from any device on your local network via browser.
help.networkServerTip: Once enabled, other devices can connect using the displayed IP address. The server mirrors the full app functionality.
help.viewerDesc: Set the default viewer mode (vertical scroll or lateral page-flip), adjust vertical image width, and choose reading direction (LTR/RTL).
help.viewerTip: Vertical mode is ideal for webtoons, while lateral mode mimics traditional manga reading. You can override the default per-tab.
help.keyboardDesc: Configure the panic key — a single key press that instantly returns you to the home screen.
help.keyboardTip: Useful for quick privacy. The panic key works from any screen in the application.
help.advancedDesc: Control history tracking, image info overlay, thumbnail generation, minimum image size filter, and auto-add dropped folders.
help.advancedTip: Disabling history will stop tracking your reading progress. Adjusting minimum image size helps filter out cover art and logos.
help.tabsDesc: Enable memory saving to unmount inactive tabs, or restore your tab session on startup.
help.tabsTip: Memory saving reduces RAM usage but causes a brief reload when switching tabs. Disabling it gives instant tab switching.
help.updatesDesc: Manage automatic updates. The app checks for new versions on startup when enabled.
help.updatesTip: Updates are downloaded in the background and applied on restart. You can also check manually at any time.
help.dangerZoneDesc: Reset all settings to defaults or clear the entire application cache including history, downloads, and data.
help.dangerZoneTip: Clearing cache is irreversible. Your settings will be preserved, but all reading history, downloads, and usage data will be permanently deleted.

settings.confirmClearCache: This will delete all history, cached data, downloads, and app usage data. Settings will be preserved. Are you sure?
settings.clearCacheError: Failed to clear cache. Please restart the app and try again.
settings.tabMemorySavingDesc: Unmount inactive tabs to save memory. Disable for instant tab switching.

help.title: How to use
help.overviewDesc: AI-powered colorization converts black and white manga pages into full color images. The colorizer runs locally on your machine using deep learning models.
help.step1: Click 'Start Server' to initialize the colorizer backend. First-time setup downloads Python and dependencies automatically.
help.step2: Drag and drop manga images or folders onto the left panel, or click 'Select Folder' to browse.
help.step3: Select an image and click 'Colorize' to process it, or use 'Colorize All' for batch processing.
help.settingsDesc: Fine-tune the colorization output with these processing options:
help.colorize: Colorize — applies AI colorization to convert grayscale to color.
help.upscale: Upscale — increases resolution using AI super-resolution for sharper details.
help.denoise: Denoise — reduces noise and artifacts from scanned images for cleaner results.
help.downloadDesc: After colorization, download individual images or all processed images at once.
help.autoFolder: Auto mode saves to a '_colorized' folder next to the originals.
help.manualFolder: Manual mode prompts you to choose a save location each time.
help.tipServer: Keep the server running while processing. Stopping it will interrupt ongoing colorization.
help.tipUpscale: Enable upscaling for low-resolution manga to improve detail clarity.
help.tipBatch: Use 'Colorize All' for large batches — progress is shown in real-time.

help.title: How to use
help.overviewDesc: Libraries let you organize your manga collection into separate, independent databases. Each library has its own settings, history, and entries.
help.createDesc: Click 'New Library' to create a fresh library with a unique name. It starts empty — add folders from the Explorer to populate it.
help.openDesc: Click 'Open Library' to import an existing .db file from another location. This copies the database into your data directory and registers it.
help.activateDesc: Click 'Activate' on any library to switch to it. The active library determines which data (history, settings, entries) is currently loaded.
help.deleteDesc: Removing a library only deletes it from the registry — the .db file is preserved on disk. You can re-import it later with 'Open Library'.
help.perLibrary: Each library is independent: settings, themes, history, and explorer folders are all per-library.
help.tipDefault: The default library cannot be deleted but can be renamed or have its data cleared.
help.tipBackup: Back up your collection by copying .db files from ~/.manga-visor/ to another location.
help.tipImport: Share libraries between devices by copying the .db file and using 'Open Library' on the other machine.
